intro: Oklahoma City's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $73/month, down 5.2% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Oklahoma City metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $75, down 9% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $90. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $30 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$38.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $44 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$58. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $73, down 5.2% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Oklahoma City metro non-climate asking rent $75, down 9% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Oklahoma City alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$90.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $101 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$124.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $122 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$148.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Ranchwood Villas (~$61), South Lindsey (~$63), Rose Creek (~$64) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Highland Park (~$312) is among the highest.
Oklahoma City has about 138 facilities and 9.2 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 210,469 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026, a increase of 45.1% from the year before (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
